reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: toggleAdminStatus has a live non-test caller (MemberManagementClient.tsx:685), no trust_assumptions field in scope file, and src/lib/actions/members.ts is explicitly in scope with admin privilege escalation listed as a key security concern. Verdict is CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL (not CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY) because exploitability is conditional on the Supabase RLS UPDATE policy for the members table — if the policy permits authenticated users to set is_admin on their own row, an attacker with a valid JWT can call PATCH /rest/v1/members?supabase_auth_user_id=eq.<their-id> directly with {is_admin:true}, bypassing all app-level checks; if the RLS policy is restrictive, the mutation silently fails. The binary gap cannot be resolved without inspecting the live database policy.
